eyebrow: ServiceNow Security & Access Controls · Chapter Three
subtitle: Lesson 11 · Authentication & Single Sign-On

code:
2,000 users, local ServiceNow authentication today.
Company already runs Okta for everything else.

Leadership wants:
  1. ServiceNow moved onto SSO against the existing Okta tenant
  2. MFA enforced for every login
caption: Plan it, then explain it to a non-technical stakeholder.

steps.label: Centralized policy
steps.sub: one password policy at Okta, already managed today

steps.label: One login
steps.sub: collapses into the Okta login they already use daily

steps.label: Offboarding
steps.sub: one Okta action instead of 2,000 separate ServiceNow steps

eyebrow: What has to come from Okta
code:
Multi-Provider SSO record needs:
  Entity ID             <- from Okta admin
  SSO endpoint URL       <- from Okta admin
  Signing certificate    <- from Okta admin

Cross-team dependency: schedule the handoff first.
caption: Authorization (roles, groups, ACLs) stays untouched throughout.

code:
Request: "enforce MFA"
Correct action:  verify Okta's own MFA policy
                 covers this ServiceNow app
Wrong action:    search for a native ServiceNow
                 MFA setting that doesn't exist here
caption: Per-department MFA rules are a real request -- but an Okta policy question, out of this scope.
